style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, warm underground light
motion_rule: EVERY second something huge crosses or fills the frame: the calculator, flying earth, a coin, his snout or the collapsing wall. Lens fully covered five times
camera_moves: macro on the calculator at 0.0, wide on the tunnel at 4.6, macro on his eye at 8.0, wide again at 9.4
character: a plump velvet mole, tiny useless eyes, huge pink shovel-paws, dusty; utterly serious, never blinks at the absurd
cast: the NEIGHBOUR MOLE, seen only at 9.4: identical calculator in his paws, sitting in a heap of ringing coins, chewing calmly
props: CALCULATOR: chunky, cream plastic, BLANK buttons and BLANK screen, no digits or letters anywhere. COINS: fat brass discs. EARTH: crumbling dark soil walls of a round burrow
prop_continuity: the calculator stays in his paws the whole clip; coins never touch it, they come out of the earth; the first coin appears at 4.0 and more follow, never fewer
environment: a round earth burrow, roots overhead, a packed soil floor; nothing else in reach
lighting: warm bright light from a hole above, dust motes lit, crisp shadows, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: calm businesslike male voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: one pause only, 3.4-4.6; voiceless after 7.0, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a dry plastic click on the button, a single clear coin chime at 4.0, more chimes joining and spreading, the whole burrow ringing by 8.0

timeline.a: silent. The calculator is SHOVED into the lens filling the whole frame, blank buttons, blank screen, then pulls back into his paws
he SLAMS the calculator flat against the lens — the frame goes solid plastic for two frames — then strides at the lens holding it out, its blank screen sweeping the full width of the frame
silent. One huge paw presses the big blank button, the whole calculator bending under the press
silent. Nothing happens on the calculator. A single coin chime rings from the EARTH WALL behind him and a brass coin pushes out of the soil

he lunges edge to edge across the burrow after the sound, whole body, twice — while single huge coins begin dropping PAST THE LENS one by one, each filling the frame as it falls; the calculator stays in his paw
silent from now on. He digs: earth flies STRAIGHT INTO THE LENS in great clods, filling the frame, while the ringing multiplies behind it
silent. Macro on one tiny eye; the whole burrow is ringing now, coins pushing out of the roof and floor and rolling past the lens
silent. He rams his shoulder through the last wall of earth, the wall bursting apart across the whole frame
silent. Wide: the NEIGHBOUR mole sits in a heap of ringing coins with an identical calculator, chewing. Our mole stands in the hole, blank calculator in paw, dead still into the lens

must_appear: the calculator blank and silent all clip, the first chime coming from the EARTH and not the device, the ringing spreading to roof and floor, earth flying into the lens, the neighbour with the same calculator at the end
negative_prompt: digits, numbers, letters, cyrillic, a lit calculator screen, the calculator ringing or glowing, subtitles, watermark, night, dark scene, dim light, people, hands, floating props, a second calculator before 9.4, slow motion, speed ramp, the mole standing still in a wide shot, any voice from him after 7.0, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery, grain
